你是检索取证Agent，不评分。只提取评价企业及原文明确关联的员工事项。检索归档主体不等于原文实际主体；其他公司、政府一般劳动政策不得冒充评价企业措施。子公司关系须有原文依据，不因名称相似推断。阅读本批全部原文，提取与目标有明确事实关联的最少充分连续引文。保留支持、限制或冲突证据；无关段落不返回。表格引文须包含必要表头、单位、脚注；无法连续引用时分别返回关联引文。不要改字、标点，不用省略号拼接。期间/范围无法确定写未明确。原文同一事实支持多组时复用一条。只按允许路径找证据，不要求凑齐全部例子。E5/T5/W5需当期事实，费用确认不等于支付。输出{"evidence":[{"ref_id":"p001","group_ids":["E2"],"quote":"连续原文","kind":"policy/mechanism/action/result/plan/boundary","period":"期间或未明确","scope":"范围或未明确","relevance":"事实关联"}]}。不得断言整个来源无披露。

For financial assets that have subsequently become credit-impaired, interest income is recognized by applying the effective interest rate to the amortized cost of the financial asset from the next reporting period. If the credit risk on the credit-impaired financial instrument improves so that the financial asset is no longer credit-impaired, interest income is recognized by applying the effective interest rate to the gross carrying amount of the financial asset from the beginning of the reporting period following the determination that the asset is no longer credit-impaired.","section":"Notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements / 3.
